gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-yi: Wiry and a bit oversized, Tektur draws every curve with open ends. Noto Sans Yi follows with a deep lowercase and unlatched rounds, so a modest bump in body size would suit it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-sans-zanabazar-squ: Tektur looks like thin steel rod bent into every letter, open at each curve's end. And Noto Sans Zanabazar Square brings a soaring x-height and wide gaps, which keeps tiny text crisp beneath it.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-noto-traditional-nushu: Tektur holds a single line with zero modulation, bending it into generous, outsized lowercase. Noto Traditional Nushu fills the line with broad-nibbed bowls that never curl shut, giving the page a softer, handwritten footing.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-numans: Rigid, rod-like headlines up top. Numans sits below with tightly coiled lowercase, hanging s-ends and generous tracking, a texture the uniform strokes of Tektur set off nicely.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-onest: Approachable is the body's mood: Onest tucks short ascenders above big bowls in a gentle, steady line. And beneath Tektur's wiry, outsized headline, a long page of it would read smoothly, without ink pooling at the turns.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-orienta: Orienta reads open and hollow, its cases nearly level in height. Tektur's uniform, wire-like headings sit above it, so the page gets one expressive voice and one quiet, breathing one.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-oxygen: Oxygen reads with curves that never close back on themselves and lowercase nearly matching its capitals. Oxygen would carry a long passage easily, a quiet counterpoint to Tektur's swell-free, expressive headlines.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-parkinsans: Parkinsans reads crisp and modern, with one stroke thickness and wide-mouthed letters that survive shrinking. Tektur's wiry headings sit above, and a long passage stays easy.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-pathway-extreme: Chunky rounded lowercase under a wiry headline. Pathway Extreme brings stubby ascenders and a big x-height, and Tektur, with no hairlines or swells anywhere, makes that sturdy body feel playful.
gen-gf-tektur-gf-preahvihear: Tektur has no thick and thin contrast at all, just generous openings and oversized lowercase. Preahvihear lifts its lofty x-height gently, so longer text reads easily.
